content: Pathlight School is an educational institution in Singapore specifically designed to cater to children with autism. It began operations in January 2004 and currently serves over 240 students, ranging in age from 6 to 16 years old. The school provides an autism-friendly environment where students can follow a mainstream academic curriculum. Additionally, it offers specialized educational programs aimed at teaching life skills to students with autism and related developmental disorders. In January 2006, Pathlight School launched a unique initiative called Café@Pathlight, a specialized Starbucks café. This café was established to help students aged 12 to 15 acquire basic work and life skills. Prior to the café's opening, volunteers and staff from Pathlight School underwent intensive training with Starbucks for a period of three to four weeks. This training equipped them with the necessary skills and knowledge to effectively teach and guide the students in their roles at the café. At present, Pathlight School operates out of the former Chong Boon Primary School building located in Ang Mo Kio. However, plans are in place to relocate the school to a new facility near Townsville Primary School by 2009. The construction of this new building is projected to cost 4.5 million Singapore dollars.
